# Version 4.154.0
> **Skia m154 release** · Released October 12, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.154.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.154.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.154.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.400/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.154.0 updates the bundled renderer to Skia m154 and ships compiler XML documentation with packages. The release refreshes HarfBuzzSharp bindings from the bundled native source and includes upstream rendering fixes. Review the breaking changes before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **HarfBuzz combining-class enum member renamed** — UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 is now named CCC132 to match upstream HarfBuzz; update source code using the old member name. ([#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))
- **HarfBuzz aggregate glyph flag removed** — GlyphFlags.Defined is no longer exposed because it is an aggregate mask. Combine the concrete flags needed by your application instead. ([#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))
- **RAW and DNG image decoding disabled** — RAW and DNG images are no longer decoded by the bundled engine. Use another decoder or convert those images before loading them with SkiaSharp. ([#5190](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5190))

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m154** — Moves the bundled renderer to Skia m154 and incorporates upstream bug, buffer-upload, and failed-flush cache fixes. ([#4945](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4945), [#5054](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5054), [#5114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5114), [#5253](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5253))

## API Surface

- **Package XML documentation now ships with the managed assemblies** — API documentation is authored in C# XML comments and included alongside NuGet assemblies, improving IntelliSense and offline API reference availability. ([#5053](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5053), [#5064](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5064), [#5066](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5066), [#5078](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5078), [#5080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5080), [#5091](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5091))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.400

HarfBuzzSharp bindings now follow the HarfBuzz source pinned for the bundled native library, keeping ordinary managed types and enum values synchronized.
